PASSED HORS D’OEUVRES
From 6pm to 8.15pm
Spicy tuna tartare, crispy rice cake, furikake GF, DF, NF
Requires oven, refrigeration.
Mix Tuna with dressing, add salt if necessary and keep very cold. Heat rice cake until warm, top with 1.5tsp of tuna and top with one piece of scallion.
Chicken schnitzel, red cabbage, Dijon, lemon NF
Requires oven, burner, pack pump mister.
Heat the braised red cabbage and place it into a plastic pastry bag. Fill the spray bottle with the lemon juice. Heat the chicken schnitzel then mist each piece with a little lemon juice, pipe a dollop of warm red cabbage in the center of the schnitzel finish with a dot Dijon mustard.
Seared rare wagyu ‘lollipop’ with fleur de sel on pronged skewers GF, DF, NF
Requires oven, pack square shot glass for skewers, and wagyu skewers.
Hot, rare, cut at a slight angle about ¼” thick, fleur de sel, glass or bowl for used skewers
King trumpet mushroom, braised brussels, togarashi, mushroom cracker VEGAN, DF, NF
Requires oven, pack hand held fine mesh strainer.
Let the mushroom puree come to room temperature, and lightly warm the brussels. Lay out crackers, place 1 tsp of mushroom puree in the center of the cracker, top with 1 tsp of brussels, and sprinkle with togarashi. Top with raw mushroom disk, dust with porcini powder.
Puffed Parmesan, truffled puree, whipped honey V, NF
Artistically place two dollops of mushroom truffle puree, citrus gel, and dot a dollop of Parmesan gelee on a puffed cracker. Garnish the cracker with flower petals and fresh thyme.
Truffled grilled cheese sandwich with celery relish V, NF
Requires oven.
Heat until cheese melts, blot as needed; garnish with small dollop of celery relish.
